name: djenriquez-core
description: Agent workflow skills for spec writing and review, plain-language engineering text, code review, decision audits, PR feedback, self-review, PR publishing, visual PR explanations, and narrated lecture videos.

interface.shortDescription: Spec writing, humanizer, reviews, decision audits, PR feedback, publishing, visual PR explanations, and lecture videos.
interface.longDescription: Write and review specs, edit engineering prose, review code, audit implementation decisions, handle PR feedback, and publish pull requests. Visual review skills create reviewer diagrams or open a local interactive view. Self-review verifies fixes with fresh reviewers and publishes one squashed commit. Lecture video turns a document or PR into an animated, locally narrated MP4 with captions.
defaultPrompt: Audit silent decisions on this PR
Add a reviewer figure to this PR
Open an interactive review of this PR
Make a narrated lecture video from this doc
Publish this branch as a PR
